description: This Java source file defines the SecureView activity, demonstrating security measures for touch input in Android views, including filtering touches when obscured and custom touch event handling to prevent spoofing attacks.

classes.name: SecureView
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating view security techniques against touch spoofing, including overlay display and touch filtering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up buttons and their actions, including overlay display and touch filtering.

methods.name: showOverlay
methods.description: Displays a custom overlay as a toast to simulate overlay attacks.

methods.name: setClickedAction
methods.description: Assigns a click listener to a button that shows a dialog with a message.

methods.name: setTouchFilter
methods.description: Adds a touch listener to a button to filter touches when the window is obscured.
